stem.text: A crane has an arm to which is attached a frictionless pulley. A cable passes over the pulley and supports a load of $10\,\text{kN}$ as shown.

stem.alt: Crane arm with a frictionless pulley at its top end. A cable passes over the pulley: one side is labelled 10 kN with an arrow pointing away from the pulley, the other side is labelled F with an arrow pointing up and away from the pulley. A load hangs from the other side, labelled 10 kN with a downward arrow. Angles of 30° are marked between the cable, the crane arm and the vertical.

stem.text: The crane arm exerts a force $F$ on the pulley.
